intentions.title: Reserve npm package names for the 1.1 GROQ query-language and React Query/Server Components integrations without letting projects silently ship against an empty surface
intentions.evidence: js/packages/groq/src/index.ts and js/packages/nextjs-query/src/index.ts are both deliberate eager-throw stubs ('@barkpark/groq is not implemented in 1.0... Deferred to 1.1') rather than empty or silently-no-op modules; js/CLAUDE.md documents them as '1.1 roadmap, reserved npm names' pointing to docs/decisions/deferred.md.

intentions.title: Point 1.0 users at the working alternative instead of leaving them stuck when a roadmap package isn't ready
intentions.evidence: Both deferred stubs' JSDoc and thrown Error messages redirect to concrete 1.0 replacements: groq stub says use client.docs('post').where(...).find() filter-builder DSL; nextjs-query stub says use useOptimisticDocument() from @barkpark/nextjs/actions.

intentions.title: Give every published SDK package (codegen, groq, nextjs-query, react, create-barkpark-app) a uniform, reproducible build+test toolchain (tsup + vitest) so the monorepo ships consistent artifacts
intentions.evidence: Every package under js/packages/* carries its own tsup.config.ts and vitest.config.ts (codegen, groq, nextjs-query, react, create-barkpark-app), keeping build/test config co-located and independently versionable per package.

intentions.title: Ship create-barkpark-app as an executable Node CLI scaffolder pinned to a specific runtime and version banner
intentions.evidence: js/packages/create-barkpark-app/tsup.config.ts sets platform:'node', target:'node20.9', banner:{js:'#!/usr/bin/env node'}, and injects __BARKPARK_VERSION__ ('1.0.0-preview.0') at build time for the scaffolder binary.

intentions.title: Keep @barkpark/react framework-free (zero next imports) while still supporting React Server Component boundaries correctly via dual CJS/ESM output and selective 'use client' directives
intentions.evidence: js/packages/react/tsup.config.ts builds separate index and server entries in both cjs/esm, externalizes react/react-dom/@barkpark/core, and its onSuccess hook prepends 'use client' only to the client-boundary bundle (index.mjs/cjs) while leaving the server entry directive-free so Next can treat it as a normal server module under the react-server condition — matching js/CLAUDE.md's description of @barkpark/react as framework-free renderers.

intentions.title: Make schema-driven typed-client codegen (barkpark generate) a first-class, independently tested package in the SDK monorepo
intentions.evidence: js/packages/codegen ships its own tsup.config.ts and vitest.config.ts; js/CLAUDE.md describes @barkpark/codegen as 'schema introspection → typed-client codegen: barkpark generate (+ --from drift gate), pairs with core typedClient<TMap>'.
